items.title: Super Bowl to Air Live on Imax Screens in Disney, NFL Deal
items.why: Premium live-event screenings are a possible experiential perk for card holders, though this deal is not itself a card partnership.
items.summary_ai: Disney and the NFL will air the Super Bowl live on IMAX screens under a new deal.
